description: Professional patient registration, appointment, laboratory, pharmacy, telehealth, billing, privacy, and patient-experience emails.
placeholder_format: Use double-brace variables, for example {{customer_name}}. Replace every placeholder before sending.

templates.name: Patient Registration Confirmation
templates.trigger: After a patient portal account is successfully created
templates.subject: Your Patient Account Has Been Created

templates.name: Appointment Confirmation
templates.trigger: After an appointment booking is confirmed
templates.subject: Appointment Confirmed – {{appointment_reference}}

templates.name: Appointment Reminder
templates.trigger: At the configured interval before an appointment
templates.subject: Reminder: Your Appointment Is Coming Up

templates.name: Appointment Rescheduling
templates.trigger: When an appointment date or time is changed
templates.subject: Update to Your Appointment – {{appointment_reference}}

templates.name: Appointment Cancellation
templates.trigger: When an appointment cancellation is completed
templates.subject: Appointment Cancellation Confirmation

templates.name: Laboratory Results Available
templates.trigger: When laboratory results are released to the patient portal
templates.subject: An Update on Your Laboratory Results
templates.body:
Dear {{patient_name}},

An update regarding your laboratory results is now available through your secure patient portal. For confidentiality, medical results are not included in this email.

Access your patient portal: {{secure_portal_url}}

Please contact {{contact_details}} if you need help accessing your results. For questions about the results, consult your treating healthcare professional.

Regards,
Laboratory Services Team
{{clinic_name}}

templates.name: Prescription Ready Notification
templates.trigger: When a prescription is ready for collection or delivery
templates.subject: Your Prescription Is Ready

templates.name: Telehealth Appointment
templates.trigger: After an online consultation is booked
templates.subject: Your Online Consultation Is Scheduled

templates.name: Patient Follow-Up
templates.trigger: After a visit when a follow-up communication is appropriate
templates.subject: Follow-Up Appointment and Care Reminder
templates.body:
Dear {{patient_name}},

Thank you for attending your recent appointment at {{clinic_name}}. Please review the follow-up instructions provided by your healthcare professional.

To arrange your next appointment, use this link: {{booking_url}}

For medical concerns, contact your healthcare provider directly. This email is an administrative reminder and is not a substitute for medical advice.

Regards,
Patient Care Team
{{clinic_name}}

templates.name: Preventive Screening Reminder
templates.trigger: When a patient is eligible for a routine screening reminder under clinic policy
templates.subject: A Reminder to Discuss Your Health Screening
templates.body:
Dear {{patient_name}},

This is a reminder that you may be due to discuss a routine health screening with a qualified healthcare professional. The appropriate screening depends on your individual circumstances and clinical guidance.

Schedule an appointment: {{booking_url}}

For questions about recommended screenings, please contact {{clinic_contact_details}}.

Regards,
Preventive Care Team
{{clinic_name}}

templates.name: Medical Bill and Payment Receipt
templates.trigger: After a patient bill payment is received
templates.subject: Payment Receipt – Invoice {{invoice_number}}

templates.name: Patient Feedback Request
templates.trigger: After a visit or completed service, subject to consent and clinic policy
templates.subject: We Value Your Feedback
templates.body:
Dear {{patient_name}},

Thank you for choosing {{clinic_name}} for your care. We are committed to improving the patient experience and would appreciate your feedback about your recent visit.

Share your feedback: {{survey_url}}

Thank you for your time.

Regards,
Patient Experience Team
{{clinic_name}}

templates.name: Privacy Policy Update
templates.trigger: When the patient privacy notice or policy is updated
templates.subject: Important Notice: Patient Privacy Policy Update
templates.body:
Dear {{patient_name}},

We have updated the privacy policy for {{clinic_name}}, effective {{effective_date}}. The updated policy explains how we handle personal information and patient data.

Review the updated policy: {{privacy_policy_url}}

Please contact our privacy team at {{privacy_contact_email}} if you have questions.

Regards,
Privacy and Compliance Team
{{clinic_name}}

templates.name: Operating Hours or Holiday Notice
templates.subject: Important Notice: Changes to Clinic Operating Hours
